automation_modality.hard_work_law: Automation never substitutes for vocabulary, domain ownership, invariants, registry population, exact algorithms, proof obligations, qualification evidence, effect authority or vertical acceptance.
automation_modality.law: A model or agent may propose declarations, mappings, plans, diagnostics, rewrites or repair candidates only; deterministic parsers, typecheckers, semantic owners, solvers, proof checkers and authorities decide whether they enter a compilation.
automation_modality.removal_law: Removing every optional model or agent extension preserves parsing, resolution, lowering, constraint solving, proof checking, artifact planning, diagnostics and evidence production; explicitly requested assistance may instead yield capability_unavailable.
